leadRow.title: A stop instruction is only one part of agent containment

evidence.sourceTitle: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
evidence.significance: OpenAI says Control Room can halt further model output within 35 seconds after receiving a stop instruction and denies inference if the control service is unavailable. This is its account of research infrastructure, not proof that completed actions can be reversed or that an enterprise deployment has the same control.

sourceDateVerification.reason: The 9 November announcement date is independently recorded by Japan AISI’s 13 November roundup. OpenAI’s primary page describes the stop-instruction boundary, inference enforcement and fail-closed design.

leadRow.title: APRA links AI risk with shared provider dependencies

evidence.sourceTitle: APRA's System Risk Outlook - November 2026 | APRA
evidence.significance: APRA says AI can create risks within firms and accelerate external threats, while shared material providers can transmit disruption. Some individual providers support institutions holding more than half of APRA-regulated financial assets; this is Australian supervisory evidence, not a measurement of any individual firm’s exposure.

leadRow.title: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
leadRow.source: Primary / Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority / 2026-10-09

evidence.sourceTitle: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority
evidence.significance: SIMEX26 involved 38 major banks and market infrastructure operators responding to a global cloud-services disruption scenario. The Bank of England says firms are expected to take action from the exercise. Participation shows rehearsal, not recovery capability; the practical test is whether findings changed service plans, supplier arrangements or response decisions.

leadRow.title: FSB calls for stronger stablecoin oversight in Türkiye

evidence.sourceTitle: FSB recommends Türkiye further strengthens its regulatory framework for crypto-assets and stablecoins
evidence.significance: The FSB recommends a dedicated stablecoin regime, stronger supervision and enforcement, and cross-border cooperation in Türkiye. These are recommendations to authorities, not new obligations already imposed on firms.

leadRow.title: FINMA sets January start for revised AML requirements
leadRow.source: Primary / Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority / 2026-11-10

evidence.sourceTitle: FINMA publishes partially revised FINMA Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance
evidence.significance: FINMA says its revised anti-money-laundering ordinance enters into force on 1 January 2027. The associated self-regulation provides a four-month transition period; affected firms must assess which provisions apply to their own activities.

leadRow.title: GSocket persistence can survive the initial application patch

evidence.sourceTitle: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2
evidence.significance: Microsoft describes attackers using an outbound relay after compromising internet-facing applications. Patching the initial flaw does not itself remove the relay client or persistence; the report describes observed telemetry rather than the prevalence of compromise across banks.

leadRow.title: Google Cloud’s London region outage exposes cross-zone recovery limits

evidence.sourceTitle: Google Cloud Service Health incident: europe-west2
evidence.significance: Google’s preliminary report describes a power event in europe-west2-b followed by capacity constraints and impact across the London region. Firms should check whether cross-zone failover and critical-service recovery work under regional control-plane and capacity stress.

sourceDateVerification.reason: Google Cloud Status incident page states the event date as 20 October and describes the europe-west2-b power event and subsequent regional impacts.

leadRow.title: European regulators link data protection with value in finance
leadRow.source: Primary / Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés / 2026-10-16

evidence.sourceTitle: De la protection des données à la création de valeur en finance : des autorités européennes publient une étude et des bonnes pratiques
evidence.organisation: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
evidence.significance: CNIL, the UK ICO and Luxembourg’s CNPD jointly examine how data protection and governance affect trust, resilience, AI use and the valuation of financial data. This is joint analysis and good practice, not a new rule.

sourceDateVerification.reason: The CNIL primary page displays 16 October 2026 beneath the headline and describes the joint CNIL, ICO and CNPD study. The date was checked directly on the primary page.
